observations.body: After John’s arrest, Jesus announces God’s Good News, fulfilled time, a near Kingdom, repentance, and belief.
observations.label: The time is fulfilled

observations.body: The passage places God’s Kingdom beside the time is fulfilled.
observations.label: God’s Kingdom

payload.posture: Read Mark 1:12–17 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states after John’s arrest, Jesus announces God’s Good News, fulfilled time, a near Kingdom, repentance, and belief. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
payload.title: The time is fulfilled
